name: Jordan Read
bio: Jordan develops and implements CUAHSI's overall strategy, maintains and builds partner relationships, and helps ensure organizational sustainability. Prior to CUAHSI, Jordan established the USGS Water Data Science Branch, advancing capabilities in modeling, data visualization, and reproducible science. He holds a Ph.D. in Civil Engineering (Environmental Fluid Mechanics) from the University of Wisconsin–Madison.

name: Anthony Castronova
bio: Anthony leads hydrology research at CUAHSI, managing a team that designs and develops software solutions bridging CUAHSI data initiatives and scientific applications. His work emphasizes hydrologic modeling, cloud computing, and reproducible science. Prior to CUAHSI, he was a Research Assistant Professor at Utah State University. He holds a B.S. in Civil Engineering from Clarkson University and M.S./Ph.D. in Civil and Environmental Engineering from the University of South Carolina.
fun_fact: Anthony enjoys playing tennis, fly fishing, skiing, and mountain biking.

name: Emily Clark
bio: Prior to joining CUAHSI, Emily worked as a Shorebird Monitor at Cape Cod National Seashore. She holds a BS in Environmental Science from the University of Tampa, an MPA in Environmental Science and Policy from Columbia University, a PMP certification, and a Waterfront Edge Design Guidelines Associate certification.
fun_fact: Emily recently completed her fourth marathon.

name: Lindsay Platt
role: Environmental Data Scientist, Lead of Operations (acting)
bio: Lindsay applies data science to support CUAHSI operations and interdisciplinary research through automated data processing, reporting, and visualizations. Previously a Water Data Scientist at USGS.

name: Martin Seul
bio: Martin leads development of CUAHSI's data services and contributes to software engineering and IT management. He holds a Diplom in Geography (MSc equivalent) from the University of Marburg an der Lahn, Germany.

name: Irene Garousi-Nejad
bio: Irene supports CUAHSI's water science research and education activities, extending capabilities in hydrologic modeling, data analysis, and cloud computing. Before joining CUAHSI, she was a postdoctoral researcher in Earth System Science at Stanford University. She holds a doctoral degree from Utah State University and a master's degree from the University of Tehran.
fun_fact: Irene enjoys hiking, reading, painting, and learning about outer space.

name: Danielle Tijerina-Kreuzer
bio: Danielle contributes to water data management, hydrologic modeling, and education activities. She specializes in physics-based hydrologic modeling, groundwater–surface water interactions, and HPC workflows. She holds a Ph.D. in Civil and Environmental Engineering from Princeton University.

name: Abner Bogan
bio: Abner supports interdisciplinary research teams in the Critical Zone Network with data management and curation, and assists in CUAHSI education and outreach. He holds a MASc in Chemical and Biological Engineering and a MEL in Clean Energy Engineering from the University of British Columbia, and a BS in Mechanical Engineering from the University at Buffalo.
fun_fact: Abner is an avid musician/producer and loves to practice Spanish!

name: Kimberlee Wong
bio: Kimberlee helps researchers follow FAIR and reproducible data science principles to manage and publish water data through HydroShare. She holds a Master of Environmental Data Science from UC Santa Barbara.

name: Kaysa Vaarre-Lamoureux
bio: Kaysa transforms internal data into actionable insights for improved decision-making. Previously a water data scientist at USGS developing interactive dashboards and reproducible data pipelines.

name: Julia Masterman
bio: Julia manages the development and execution of CUAHSI's education and outreach activities. She holds a BA in Earth and Environmental Sciences from Boston University.
fun_fact: Julia spent 6 months in New Zealand, and another month readjusting to driving on the right side of the road.

name: Lisa Mucciacito
bio: Lisa executes CUAHSI's strategy to engage its constituency through visual and textual content, communications strategies, monthly newsletters, and social media. She holds a bachelor's in Costume and Textile Design from UC Davis and an MS in Sustainability Management from Columbia University.
fun_fact: Lisa loves partner dancing and her favorite styles are Hustle, Cha Cha and Salsa on 2!

name: Brianna Kearns
bio: Brianna provides operational, logistical, and programmatic support for CUAHSI's training, events, and community engagement activities. She holds a BS in Biology (Marine Biology) from the University of Massachusetts Dartmouth.
fun_fact: Brianna enjoys hiking and kayaking, especially after a fresh snowfall.

name: Scott Black
bio: Scott supports the HydroShare team and CZ Hub data portal development, providing stability in software development and maintenance activities critical to HydroShare's long-term sustainability. He holds a B.S. in Computer Science from Utah State University.

name: Zahraa Alhmood
bio: Zahraa builds tools and systems that help scientists share, publish, and collaborate on water data. She develops backend services, improves data workflows, and supports cloud-based infrastructure for open and reproducible research. She holds a BSE in Computer Engineering from the University of Michigan.
fun_fact: Zahraa enjoys reading, painting, and hiking!

name: Callie Porter-Borden
bio: Callie contributes to CUAHSI's core services and research projects. Previously worked in health tech building scalable data systems including cloud-native services, ETL pipelines, APIs, and workflow automation.

name: Summer Conley
bio: Summer applies expertise in program development, operations management, and nonprofit accounting to support CUAHSI's daily operations and project execution. She holds a B.S. in Public Policy and Administration from James Madison University.
fun_fact: Summer has been fostering rescue animals for over ten years!

name: Laura Davis
bio: Laura manages CUAHSI's day-to-day financial activities. She holds a BS in Accounting from UMass Boston and an MBA from Suffolk University.
fun_fact: Laura is an amateur runner and hopes to complete her first marathon.

name: Maureen Ako
bio: Maureen focuses on regulatory compliance and overseeing annual audits, bringing experience from key leadership roles in nonprofit accounting departments.
fun_fact: Maureen enjoys watching the Premier League and her favorite team is Chelsea.

name: Barbara Walker
bio: Barbara supports pre-award and post-award grant administration with a focus on compliance, reporting, subrecipient monitoring, and grant closeout. She holds an MS in Accountancy from the University of Phoenix.

name: Courtney Di Vittorio
bio: Courtney is a CUAHSI Visiting Scholar and an Associate Professor of Engineering at Wake Forest University. She holds a PhD in Civil Engineering from Georgia Tech with a focus on Water Resources, and a professional engineering license.
fun_fact: Courtney recently started learning Taekwondo alongside her husband and two daughters.

name: Devin Cowan
bio: Devin is passionate about open-source software and reproducible science. Studies Environmental Engineering; based in Brattleboro, VT.

name: Neal DeBuhr
bio: Neal leads software and quality assurance activities at CUAHSI. He holds a BS in Mechanical Engineering and has previously improved business operations through software implementation and systems integration.
